# RPC commands

## brp rpc discover

List every JSON-RPC method the remote BRP endpoint exposes

```text
List every JSON-RPC method the remote BRP endpoint exposes

Usage: bevy_copilot brp rpc discover [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --host <HOST>        Host of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_HOST, default 127.0.0.1)
      --port <PORT>        Port of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_PORT, default 15702)
      --compact <COMPACT>  Compact (single-line) JSON output instead of pretty: true|false [possible values: true, false]
  -h, --help               Print help
```

MCP peer: `brp_rpc_discover`

## brp rpc execute

Call any BRP method advertised by rpc.discover with verbatim JSON params

```text
Call any BRP method advertised by rpc.discover with verbatim JSON params

Usage: bevy_copilot brp rpc execute [OPTIONS] <METHOD>

Arguments:
  <METHOD>  JSON-RPC method name to call — any method advertised by rpc.discover, core BRP (e.g. `world.query`) or app-registered (e.g. `my_game/reset_level`)

Options:
      --host <HOST>        Host of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_HOST, default 127.0.0.1)
      --params <PARAMS>    Params JSON passed through verbatim (omitted when not given)
      --port <PORT>        Port of the BRP HTTP endpoint (env BEVY_BRP_PORT, default 15702)
      --compact <COMPACT>  Compact (single-line) JSON output instead of pretty: true|false [possible values: true, false]
  -h, --help               Print help
```

MCP peer: `brp_execute`
